inputs_source: generated: images are numpy default_rng draws and closed-form gradients encoded by PIL 12.3 (libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1), cjpeg 3.2.0 (libjpeg-turbo) and this script's coefficient-level writer; the fuzz corpus is a seeded byte mutator over those files (random.Random, seed 2026). Encoder output is stable for a given tool version; every golden is torchvision 0.29.1's decode (libjpeg-turbo 3.1.3) of the exact input file.
